_comment: Example Sentry configuration file. Export a real one from a working instance (Configuration > Download configuration, or GET /api/config) rather than hand-writing this — the shape is validated on import and an exported file is always correct. An export NEVER contains the hotspot password: `passphrase_set` only reports whether the source had one. To provision a fresh Pi to a working hotspot in one import, hand-add a "passphrase" key to the hotspot section below — it is read on import and, being import-only, can never reappear in a file Sentry exports. Treat any file you add one to as a secret. Still absent entirely: the .env-only deploy gates SENTRY_HOTSPOT_CONTROL_ENABLED and SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN. See docs/adr/0007 for why.
